notes.title: Contagion - Game-mode Specific Servers are up now, DLC Progress, and more!
notes.content:
http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2015-07-14_Contagion_DLC_Weapons/DLC_Art_620x355.jpg

Game-Mode Specific Servers
As there were many requests we worked with Gameservers who hosts our Official Contagion servers to set it up so we could create Game-Mode Specific Servers.

Look for Official Contagion Escape, Extraction, Hunted, and Classic Panic Servers!

If you run into issues we should know about regarding the above please refer to the pinned discussion-
http://steamcommunity.com/app/238430/discussions/0/527274088396735140/

DLC Progress
We are still fixing Multiplayer bugs with Flatline where thankful survivors offering support match the smartphones directions (currently more than one area is active but should be fixed soon), some navigation issues, and a crash bug we're tracking down.

Character's are all done but having to link voices correctly which is being worked on now and will release shortly

Misc.
We're working on a large Escape map with a focus on both indoor and outdoor exploration and objectives is coming along fantastically and will include many other game-modes likely with flatline as well.

We will be focusing after the release of our remaining DLC on noted bugs by team and community as well as improved Matchmaking, Lobby System, New Animation System with over 500 new animations, New Zombies including some uniques that are being tested (unique like Riot Zombies but a bit more terrifying), and for all including Linux/Mac users we still have plans with Valve to visit and discuss possible move to new/updated Engine for support of the above mentioned platforms and other improvements.

We are working on a PR schedule with our new PR Lead Bastian who will try to keep everyone better informed and in the loop with media and more as it's been difficulty to set aside time for posting announcements and don't want you all thinking we're not hard at work. We have a ridiculous amount of new content being created daily and will be released in the near future but it's always nice to see what is going on. Bastian is best known for artwork for loading screens and our teasers, trailers, and other video work.

We are always grateful to the Emails and Messages from the community showing their support and the incredible patience you've shown us. Thank you!

-The Contagion Team

http://www.contagion-game.com/site_images/networks/steam.png http://www.contagion-game.com/site_images/networks/facebook.png http://www.contagion-game.com/site_images/networks/twitter.png http://www.contagion-game.com/site_images/networks/youtube.png http://www.contagion-game.com/site_images/networks/indiedb.png

notes.title: Contagion - DLC Weapons Released... Read on!
notes.content:
http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2015-07-14_Contagion_DLC_Weapons/DLC_Art_620x355.jpg

Here is our second attempt at releasing the new weapons for those who missed the previous update we had to pull due to game breaking bug. Basically the DLLs required a special signature that when generated on a new machine was rejected and had to be done differently even with the documentation contradicting this. 

We apologize for the delay but so long as no serious bugs crop up we should be good to release more content soon such as Flatline and New Characters. Each are very close to release ready (the new voices sound great) and we're excited to be able to release all this extra content and some bug fixes with today's update!

New DLC Weapons To Look Out For
http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2015-01-25_ContagionAnnouncement/Free_DLC_Weapon_Preview.jpg

July was a rough month for us and we really want to thank everyone who Emailed and contacted us showing their support. I (Tatsur0) may receive a lot of flak for my laid back nature or in other cases holding to the rules & guidelines and I'm not stranger to this but our failures definitely hit home and I can't thank you enough for the love and support and will do everything we can to repay all of you!

We will be increasing the pace when it comes to releasing bug fixes, polish, and new features so be sure to check back -HERE- in the case you may have missed an announcement!

-The Contagion Team

notes.title: Contagion - Summer Sale, DLC Release, and Intel Showcase!
notes.content:
http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2015-06-12_Release_Sale_Showcase/2015_Contagion_Summer_Sale.jpg

As everyone knows by now Steam is having it's yearly Summer Sale and they've got quite a bit of entertainment for us as well as some very sweet deals so do not miss out!

Contagion is on sale as well as the 4-Pack at 50% Off So check it out and share with your friends!

http://store.steampowered.com/app/238430/

http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2015-06-12_Release_Sale_Showcase/Contagion_DLC.jpg

But let's get to the real news regarding Contagion and that would be our Free DLC Bundle. After a poorly timed fiasco last year we've had to rebuild our team and learn from scratch quite a bit of work (please read our pinned thread on the details). This has delayed major releases including our Free DLC Bundle but we're tired of waiting and tired of making you guys wait.

While much of our content is linked due to the overhaul of the Source Engine and optimization as well as improved audio with Wwise we've managed to split the release into a few parts and will be delivering them asap starting today with our Map Release!

3 Gigabytes of Contagion Assets are currently being uploaded to Steam and in a few hours your copy of Contagion is going to either automatically start updating or ask that you update. We've been very busy even during the struggle that started last year and we believe modders will appreciate the ludicrous amount of content to work with and veteran players will notice significant improvements to existing environments. But today's release is focused on our MAP RELEASE with the below maps.

(We will be having all Official Servers Updated tomorrow)

https://youtu.be/NkpYVQGyWu0

Contagion DLC :: Map Release

CE_Harvest

http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2015-06-12_Release_Sale_Showcase/ce_harvest_preview_th.jpg

CE_CampWhitner :: CX_CampWhitner :: CH_CampWhitner

http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2015-06-12_Release_Sale_Showcase/ce_campwhitner_preview_th.jpg

CH_UnionStation

http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2015-06-12_Release_Sale_Showcase/ch_unionstation_preview_th.jpg

We will be releasing the new weapons, characters, and the new game-mode flatline as soon as these are ready or at least not as clumsy as they feel right now. The maps we've been having a blast on today making them release ready and will be reading your input as you play them. Modders will have much more content to work with and older maps have received some major polishing. Because there was soooo much work being done, so many devs being vetted, and confusion late last year and early this year there is no way to go over all the changes unfortunately but many veterans will notice the changes immediately to all existing content.

http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2015-06-12_Release_Sale_Showcase/Intel_Logo_620.png

Also wanted to share that we were invited and put on the Intel Showcase and have some other exciting news we hope we can share in the near future. That said, keep checking back on the next DLC release!

Someone asked us why we would waste our DLC during a Sale and lose the value behind marketing it. We told em we couldn't stand making you wait and that was costing us more.

Want to thank everyone for being so incredibly supportive and patient as we got our house in order. Looking forward to releasing content on a more regular basis once again.

-The Contagion Team

http://www.contagion-game.com/site_images/networks/steam.png http://www.contagion-game.com/site_images/networks/facebook.png http://www.contagion-game.com/site_images/networks/twitter.png http://www.contagion-game.com/site_images/networks/youtube.png http://www.contagion-game.com/site_images/networks/indiedb.png

notes.title: Contagion - DLC Progress & "Contagious Gaming" Stream & Giveaway (6:30PM PST)
notes.content:
http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2014-07-18_ContagiousGaming04/contagious_gaming_preview_620.jpg

Sorry for the delay guys but today we've made some serious progress and that is both good and bad for today's Stream! Due to the work we're doing I've got Alex working with the team to continue our progress and he will not be joining us on today's Stream. I'll also be starting the Stream late... clearly. Today's Stream & Giveaway will not be of Contagion as that's in development atm and we don't have the numbers to stream it properly nor do I want to halt the momentum. We will be playing "Hand of Fate" which a friend and fan thought you might enjoy and he will be joining Skype to read comments and follow the game real-time as it is Single-Player.

Just a quick progress update-

 All maps are ready
 All weapons are ready
 All characters are ready with some slight issue with voices but being fixed
 Flatline has 2 known issues. Weapon and Zombie spawns but we believe we caught the issue and hope to provide more info soon. Too many bugs cropped up during the overhaul of code but our new Programmer has been working very hard to solve this. The entire team have been pounding out quality work daily and that includes weekends.

notes.title: Contagion - Free DLC Update Status and more!
notes.content:
http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2015-04-22_DLC_Status/Free_DLC_Status_Header.png

I want to first thank everyone for their patience and for those who are still wondering why it's taken as long as it has please review our General Discussion Pinned threads explaining much of the delays but not as in depth as I would like considering so many had to start from scratch without documented work to refer to which will not be an issue in the future.

Overview
As many of you already know, Monochrome has repeatedly posted that all Contagion content including the larger DLC Bundles will be released free of charge for all those who own Contagion and that we're currently working on our first DLC bundle release.

For the sake of having a date set we are going to state April 30th, 2015 is our release date. We don't expect it to be delayed beyond this date (or I wouldn't have listed it) but will apologize in advance if any unforeseen circumstances (as it should be clear by now this isn't uncommon) were to push that date out a bit.

We are also requesting Valve schedule a Free Weekend with discount so that friends and family can experience the new content and potentially purchase it at a lower price.

What to expect from DLC

4 New Characters (includes their own unique voice actors)

 Mia
 Curtis
 Yumi
 Manuel

4 New Weapons

 Compound Bow (Actually trying to do some unique animations never done in source before but won't let it delay release if we can't sort it out before date)
 Remington 870
 M1 Garand
 SCAR

 2 New Maps

 Union Station
 Harvest

 1 New Game-Mode

 Flatline (Prefix CF_) which is a waved based survival game mode that will focus heavily on watching each others back, gathering resources, unlocking new areas, and saving your fellow survivors after they've been severely injured and will be the first game-mode we've released where there is no player zombies in the design.



Where we are on the status of each asset/mode

 Characters

 All Characters are in-game each with their own unique voice actor and personality with the exception of Curtis who we are still working on voice for.

 Weapons

 All 4 weapons are complete, in-game, with unique sounds and animations

 Maps

 Both maps are complete with extensive playtesting but Union Station is being modified as we polish up Flatline.

 Game-Mode

 Flatline is coming along nicely but we're still adjusting for balancing and testing as we didn't want to just fling a simple survival mode in there which can already be done by modders in other game-modes.



How confident are we about release
We're actually quite confident but know if we run into an issue like we did with animations and how they were originally setup and the research time it took to sort out and implement the updated ones which we don't expect to happen but when including new content a lot of people are involved and the tinniest mistake can lead to delays. That said if I wasn't comfortable with April I wouldn't have stated that's the release month and now we have a day (if we release earlier... yay?).

What about the existing bugs and less than user friendly features?
Many bug fixes are already included in this release like the local co-op cockroach glitch and we will definitely be implementing and polishing up new and existing features that will make playing Contagion easier and more enjoyable but many of these will be after this DLC Release.

What about Linux & Mac Platforms?
We spent a great deal of money to make our version of the Engine Linux/Mac friendly but hit brickwall after brickwall even with the most experienced of programmers which is what happened with Valve and so while we can't release it on these platforms now we fully intend to put all our effort into moving to an updated version of Source (who knows what our options may be at that point) when it won't affect the majority of players. We have not forgotten our pledge to support these platforms.

Oh and btw...
We already have a large map currently labelled camp that is nearly release ready for Escape, Extraction, and Hunted and another in the works. This map will expand on what we attempted to do in the past by including a unique story and possibly leading to something bigger for Contagion fans!

But you forgot...
Sorry if I missed anything but it's likely already addressed in the Official Steam Contagion Community Hub so be sure to check it out and do a search if you don't see your question answered here.

OH DON'T FORGET TO SEND CONTAGION TO E3!
We could not delay the DLC by having our Team earn points for the Indie Crash E3 promo but by supporting and playing a slightly addictive web based game you can earn points for us to bring Contagion to E3 and increase our exposure which benefits the team and the community! Some members have well over 2billion points which means they alone are 1/15th of our total points and we're in the top 20 and going up in rank. If we had a handful of users do the same we would hit top 5 easy.

WANT TO HELP? THEN CLICK THE IMAGE BELOW AND SUPPORT US!
http://media.indiedb.com/cache/images/games/1/22/21237/thumb_620x2000/e3.jpg

or click here - http://indiescrashe3.com/nomination/21D2E0A6-6D1E-22E7-AD7C-DAFBBB068094

ONLY 4-3 DAYS LEFT TO SHOW YOUR SUPPORT! Which is honestly with the help of a small small small percentage of our active community members more than enough time to get us there!

Want to once again thank everyone for all you've done for us over the years and we are still trying to repay the favor! Sorry it's taking us so long but we won't stop working away at making Contagion one of your favorite titles.

-The Contagion Team

http://www.contagion-game.com/site_images/networks/steam.png http://www.contagion-game.com/site_images/networks/facebook.png http://www.contagion-game.com/site_images/networks/twitter.png http://www.contagion-game.com/site_images/networks/youtube.png http://www.contagion-game.com/site_images/networks/indiedb.png

notes.title: Contagion - Heading to GDC 2015 and why?!
notes.content:
http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2015-02-28_GDC2015/GDC_2015_Banner.jpg

Monochrome on our way to GDC 2015
In roughly 12 hours I (Brian "Tatsur0") will be on my way to the airport to fly to San Francisco, CA for this years Game Developer's Conference where I will join up with Alex "Swolfington" & Joseph "SickJoe" to meet with friends, colleagues, publishers, and more!

But why GDC?
GDC is great for Developers and those seeking them. Quite a lot of business gets done and the simple answer is we're going out there to further secure the future of Monochrome which in includes Contagion!

Any other reason?
In fact there is another. We are excited to be sitting down with some big names regarding our next game we've been hinting at "Project Ageless". This game is inspired by the classics and today's geniuses and will be a Sci-Fi Horror title that should shake things up! If all goes well we should be able to release a bit more publicly during/after the conference!

http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2015-02-28_GDC2015/Project_Ageless_Logo.png

Wait... What about Contagion?!
Do not fret!!! We have an incredible team who are working in sync with one another and soon not only will we be releasing the DLC (once we return will be discussing a release date with the team and hopefully announcing it which will put me in the awkward position of making a promise and you should know by now I hate those) but also new maps, weapons, features such as improved matchmaking, lobby system, animation system, AI, melee, and much more... yes that includes our goal to release on Mac & Linux still knowing it's going to be a hard and long road but anyone that knows me from the Quake/GoldSrc/Source days knows I'm stubborn and am not one to quit easily. There is no reason to be concerned!

I hope you all are as excited as we are and will wish us luck on our vaca....business trip and if you happen to be at the Conference be sure to let us know by Emailing contact(at)monochrome-games(dot)com!


-The Contagion Team

notes.title: Contagion - Contagion DLC Teaser "Friday Frenzy" late but happening in 10mins!
notes.content:
http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/Contagion_Store_Announcement_Preview.png

http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2013_09_13_Kickstarter/TwitchTV_450.png

We stream our Official Contagion "Friday Frenzy" and/or "Contagious Gaming" via our Twitch.Tv Account at- http://www.twitch.tv/tatsur0 every Friday @ 5:30PM PST/PDT (GMT- 8:00) -Click here for current time- and will pass out one or more free copies of Contagion during the Stream!

Sorry we're late but we ended up screwing things up to setup this special DLC "Friday Frenzy" teaser Stream! We don't want to give everything away but in the process we had to start sorta from scratch to fix some code issues but don't worry backed up where we left off so nothing lost just delayed.

I want to thank Alex & Robert Gatson and everyone for working very hard today to help us resolve the issues.

Once again we're sorry for the delay and even though you won't get to see everything we will be showing you some sweet new DLC and giving out Contagion Keys!

Free DLC Bundle
Check out what's to come soon!

4 New Characters
http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2015-01-25_ContagionAnnouncement/Free_DLC_Character_Preview.jpg

4 New Weapons
http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2015-01-25_ContagionAnnouncement/Free_DLC_Weapon_Preview.jpg

2 New Maps
http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2015-01-25_ContagionAnnouncement/Free_DLC_Map_Preview.jpg

1 New Game-Mode
CF_ (Flatline Game-Mode) is a cooperative survival wave-based mode where your goal is to survive as long as possible (with a potential final fight). Unlike the other game modes, you do not return as a zombie when you die. When you get got, you end up in a unique "Medical Triage" location that zombies can only enter if all players perish, thus losing the round. However as long as there is one 1 living survivor at the end of a wave, all players will spawn outside the Triage and can then prepare for the next wave. Each successive wave becomes more and more difficult, and as waves come to pass, access to new area opens up. This gives the horde new ways to reach you, as well as a  chance to rescue AI survivors (they must survive the wave as well!) who will provide a cache of helpful items for the upcoming wave. Ultimately we are still striving for a unique game each and every time without any predictable patterns or spawns while also allowing for the environments to change as well.

See you soon!

-The Contagion Team

notes.title: Contagion - The Story, Finally PROGRESS, DLC Media & Info, and much more!
notes.content:
http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/Contagion_Store_Announcement_Preview.png
Many of you have been frustrated by the recent string of delays; not only for the DLC, but for seemingly simple bug fixes, and for other miscellaneous updates. We understand this is especially frustrating since in the past we had been putting out updates bi-weekly (some with significant changes!), and for this we sincerely apologize. With things finally back on track we felt it important to be a bit more transparent, and to that end we will shed some light on the reasons behind the delays and as well as share details on future updates (WHICH ARE STILL FREE TO ALL THOSE WHO OWN CONTAGION!). We are excited for the coming weeks and months and you should be too!

The Story
In case anyone is unfamiliar, the last update for the game was on October 10th, while our first Free DLC Bundle was planned for a Q4 2014 release. Unfortunately, behind the scenes we were dealing with a severe breakdown in communication and morale, fueled largely by exhaustion. 

We're not a large team, and no one wishes to express their frustration or admit feeling burned-out to friends and this is especially true when their friend is also their "boss". When these situations arise they tend to boil-over quickly, so when a well loved member of the team abruptly left to pursue other interests, we had a bit of an avalanche effect. By the end of the week we lost half our team, including Dec Doyle, our Lead and only programmer at the time. While losing Dec did set us back, I have to add that he did an exceptional job of sticking around to make sure ZombieFest went off without a hitch and is still a well respected and loved friend. Shortly after that, one of the partners and our only Composer & Sound Designer departed.

Fortunately, experience has taught us to be prepared and so we had the resources to replace many of the vacant positions, with the exception of a reliable Programmer and Composer & Sound Designer though the latter not being as urgent as we had most of the sound work completed. Frustratingly this was not the case for programmer position, and as luck would have it we ended up spending months bleeding money, hiring several individuals in a row who did not work out. It was at this point that our luck started to turn around, and we came into contact with Robert Gatson, a 20+ year Industry veteran. With a great knowledge of software development, designing Engines, excellent team building skills, and a strong interest in our current and future titles, he was/is a perfect fit.

With everything looking as good as it does, I'd love to give you a date for the Free DLC Bundle. In the spirit of not creating any more false hopes however, we can't give a solid date. We can say that we have every intention and reason to believe it will be out before the end of February. Following the DLC, we fully expect to be able to pump out bug fixes and updates at the pace many of you have come to enjoy in the past.

While Both Alex and I take full responsibility for having let you guys down, I can't express how happy we are to have the team we currently have, and especially to the community who has believed in us and showed us great patience. Thank you all, and hope you all will forgive us and join us as we move forward!

Free DLC Bundle
While we're very confident with February some of you have been eagerly waiting for a good while and so we'd like to share with you some media that is intentional set at 620 width so that you can truly appreciate it more so in-game. We have so much to show you that we wouldn't to fit in on a dozen posts but hope you appreciate this little bit!

4 New Characters
http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2015-01-25_ContagionAnnouncement/Free_DLC_Character_Preview.jpg

4 New Weapons
http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2015-01-25_ContagionAnnouncement/Free_DLC_Weapon_Preview.jpg

2 New Maps
http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2015-01-25_ContagionAnnouncement/Free_DLC_Map_Preview.jpg

1 New Game-Mode
CF_ (Flatline Game-Mode) is a cooperative survival wave-based mode where your goal is to survive as long as possible (with a potential final fight). Unlike the other game modes, you do not return as a zombie when you die. When you get got, you end up in a unique "Medical Triage" location that zombies can only enter if all players perish, thus losing the round. However as long as there is one 1 living survivor at the end of a wave, all players will spawn outside the Triage and can then prepare for the next wave. Each successive wave becomes more and more difficult, and as waves come to pass, access to new area opens up. This gives the horde new ways to reach you, as well as a  chance to rescue AI survivors (they must survive the wave as well!) who will provide a cache of helpful items for the upcoming wave. Ultimately we are still striving for a unique game each and every time without any predictable patterns or spawns while also allowing for the environments to change as well.

Additional Media
http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2015-01-25_ContagionAnnouncement/Contagion_Assets_Preview.png

Some other things to prepare for
http://steamcommunity.com/app/238430/discussions/0/620703493330724727/

-The Contagion Team

Following the DLC, we fully expect to be able to pump out bug fixes and updates at the pace many of you have come to enjoy in the past.

While Both Alex and I take full responsibility for having let you guys down, I can't express how happy we are to have the team we currently have, and especially to the community who has believed in us and showed us great patience. Thank you all, and hope you all will forgive us and join us as we move forward!

Free DLC Bundle
While we're very confident with February some of you have been eagerly waiting for a good while and so we'd like to share with you some media that is intentional set at 620 width so that you can truly appreciate it more so in-game. We have so much to show you that we wouldn't to fit in on a dozen posts but hope you appreciate this little bit!

4 New Characters
http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2015-01-25_ContagionAnnouncement/Free_DLC_Character_Preview.jpg

4 New Weapons
http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2015-01-25_ContagionAnnouncement/Free_DLC_Weapon_Preview.jpg

2 New Maps
http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2015-01-25_ContagionAnnouncement/Free_DLC_Map_Preview.jpg

1 New Game-Mode
CF_ (Flatline Game-Mode) is a cooperative survival wave-based mode where your goal is to survive as long as possible (with a potential final fight). Unlike the other game modes, you do not return as a zombie when you die. When you get got, you end up in a unique "Medical Triage" location that zombies can only enter if all players perish, thus losing the round. However as long as there is one 1 living survivor at the end of a wave, all players will spawn outside the Triage and can then prepare for the next wave. Each successive wave becomes more and more difficult, and as waves come to pass, access to new area opens up. This gives the horde new ways to reach you, as well as a  chance to rescue AI survivors (they must survive the wave as well!) who will provide a cache of helpful items for the upcoming wave. Ultimately we are still striving for a unique game each and every time without any predictable patterns or spawns while also allowing for the environments to change as well.

Additional Media
http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2015-01-25_ContagionAnnouncement/Contagion_Assets_Preview.png

Some other things to prepare for
http://steamcommunity.com/app/238430/discussions/0/620703493330724727/

notes.title: Contagion - Autumn Sale, Free DLC Bundle, Upcoming Features, and More!
notes.content:
http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2014-11-26_AutumnSale/Contagion_Autumn_Sale_2014.jpg

It's nearly Thanksgiving for many and even if you're not celebrating (in my case my family is still in Japan until immigration gives the go ahead) we still have the Steam Autumn Sale to enjoy! There are a number of great titles especially Indies on sale so don't miss out!

We have more to celebrate as we're much closer to the release of our first FREE DLC Bundle having hired more talent to speed up development (we've been stubborn about releasing quality updates and making sure our DLC is well worth the wait) of the 4 new Characters, 4 new Weapons, 2 New Maps, and our New Game-Mode Flatline with Union Station being the first of many Flatline maps. In addition to the DLC we are working on some very important features to improve the overall experience of Contagion all of which we're hoping to release before the end of the year! Here's a preview of what's to come-

Contagion - Free DLC Bundle Preview
http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2014-11-26_AutumnSale/Contagion_DLC_Survivor_Preview_th.jpg
http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2014-11-26_AutumnSale/Contagion_DLC_M1G_Preview_th.jpg
http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2014-11-26_AutumnSale/Contagion_DLC_CE_Harvest_Preview_th.jpg
http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2014-11-26_AutumnSale/Contagion_DLC_CF_UnionStation_Preview_th.jpg

Contagion - Upcoming Feature List

 Lobby System - No more struggling to host a game with friends. Create and edit a lobby for you and your friends to experience Contagion how you prefer to play
 Improved Animation System - Utilizing our new mocap animations fully to bring a more immersive experience to your games
 Ranking & Unlockables - As you play our Co-op on Official Servers you will be able to obtain rewards to customize weapons and rank up
 Improved Shader System to take advantage of shaders not yet included as well as optimize our existing setup so lower end systems can enjoy some of the shaders they were unable to till now


With another Free DLC Bundle designed and ready to be worked on we will see more Escape, Extraction, Flatline maps as well as numerous bug fixes and optimization. There are also plans to update Contagion's Engine to support Mac & Linux builds as promised. Also worth noting that we're working on a big reveal for GDC 2015 for those attending or keeping tabs on GDC and/or Contagion!

Holiday Live Stream & Giveaway
http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2013_09_13_Kickstarter/TwitchTV_450.png

We stream our Official Contagion "Friday Frenzy" and/or "Contagious Gaming" via our Twitch.Tv Account at- http://www.twitch.tv/tatsur0 every Friday @ 5:00PM PST/PDT (GMT- 8:00) -Click here for current time- and will pass out one or more free copies of Contagion during the Stream!

We will be Streaming Live this Friday a number of titles on Sale and doing our Holiday Giveaway of said titles during our Friday "Contagious Gaming" Live Stream & Giveaway at 5:00PM PST (GMT - 8:00) via http://www.twitch.tv/tatsur0

Contagion is now on Sale at $9.99 or $29.99 for a 4-Pack
http://www.monochrome-games.com/site_images/contagion-now-on-steam.png

Working with Valve we've made sure to avoid mistakes with this holiday sale so you will notice that our 4-Pack is also on sale and apologize for the Halloween Hiccup we were unable to resolve in time.

http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2013-11-28_Thanksgiving/thanksgiving_footer.png

-The Contagion Team

http://www.contagion-game.com/site_images/networks/steam.png http://www.contagion-game.com/site_images/networks/facebook.png http://www.contagion-game.com/site_images/networks/twitter.png http://www.contagion-game.com/site_images/networks/youtube.png http://www.contagion-game.com/site_images/networks/indiedb.png

notes.title: Contagion - Latest Update with New Map & Web Comic "Break Down" Finale and More
notes.content:
http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/Contagion_Store_Announcement_Preview.png

As many of you already know we released our latest update while at the same time out in Florida setting up for ZombieFest which had 30,000 people. It was quite hectic and a few mistakes with updates but we got it out just in time to open the doors to the public. 

We did not have the time we wanted to prepare the map and walking around the area we just created for Contagion we were not content with the missing textures and assets the map deserved to really fill it out but the residents of Downtown Lakeland in no way felt the same and were quite overjoyed at being able to walk around a virtual representation of the area they grew up in having been hit by the zombie apocalypse.

Now that we've got a lot of pictures, videos, and media on it's way from hundreds out there in Florida (all will be put together for a media update soon) we have the material needed to update the map and open up some of the interiors with waivers being signed and sent our way so that we can do the map justice. That being said we have had to put Lakeland on hold to focus on finishing up our first Free DLC Bundle so the entire team has and is still working on that now but with Lakeland now up on Official Server's here are some screens the update's changelog.

http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2014-10-20_CH_Lakeland/CH_Lakeland01_th.jpg
http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2014-10-20_CH_Lakeland/CH_Lakeland02_th.jpg
http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2014-10-20_CH_Lakeland/CH_Lakeland03_th.jpg
http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2014-10-20_CH_Lakeland/CH_Lakeland04_th.jpg

Contagion - Update October 8th Changelog:

 Added new map CH_Lakeland (Hunted Game-Mode) for ZombieFest sponsored by Monochrome LLC
 Added numerous assets for multiple maps
 Replaced old assets with newer & better versions
 Optimized, Fixed exploits, Bugs, and improved game-play for both Barlowe Square and Pioneer Express


We've got more on the way and again our focus is our Free DLC (which no won't be here for Halloween which is something we would have like to have done but would have been a rushed job which we try to avoid whenever possible) but still hope to have something special out there for our favorite Holiday!

Also now that we're back we've got the finale of our Official Contagion Web Comic so have a look as next week we will reveal Volume 4 "Discord" and will return to weekly FridayFrenzy's ːbashː

notes.title: Contagion - Sept 14th Update :: Significant Improvements, Update on Linux/Mac, and More
notes.content:
http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/Contagion_Store_Announcement_Preview.png

Today's update may seem smaller than it really is which has more to do with a great deal of work than the lack there of. Since our July 31st/August 1st release our focus has been on the Free 1st DLC Bundle and the Core Game Mechanics much of which is still being prototyped and tested for upcoming releases.

There hasn't been a single day of inactivity and we may have some additional surprises coming your way. Even with me flying back home to the States to save the Company additional expenses and get me on a timezone to better run things with Alex Wright (COO) I already have a powerful NoteBook to continue my work and everyone knows what they're do. I will also be making my first public appearance via a popular Talk Show on October 10th, Sponsoring and Running a Large Venue with 32 high end machines in the center of ZombieFest (with possible special guest appearance), and I think we might hit up Universal and/or DisneyWorld (never been to Florida) the day before we return.

Our Changelog is missing a considerable amount of AI Code, Optimization to Code, and further steps towards including the features we've mentioned such as an improved and much needed lobby system for those not wanting to go through the trouble of setting up a server which requires the usual Port Forwarding and more or 3rd Party Lan related software, New Animation System for our MoCap Animations, Ranking, Unlockables, Stats, and cosmetic options for players.

I will not see my family for some time as we sort Immigration which means I will be lost in my work. This year is going to be a very exciting year!

Check out today's Update (Including additions that didn't make it in the Build Changelog Text)-

Contagion - Update September 14th Changelog:

 Added new triggers and challenges to Biotec
 Added new gates to CE_StoneCreek
 Added new sounds to improve atmosphere and immersion
 Improved Sound Zones
 Optimized AI Code
 Optimized Core Engine to boost Performance
 Optimized a significant number of assets to improve quality of game-play
 Optimized the following maps. CE_RoanokePD, CE_Biotec, CE_StoneCreek, and CE_BarloweSquare
 Significantly improved Zombie Pathing & Nav Mesh in CE_RoanokePD, 
CE_Biotec, CE_StoneCreek, and CE_BarloweSquare
 Removed dozens of Bugs, Exploits, and Glitches in CE_RoanokePD, 
CE_Biotec, CE_StoneCreek, and CE_BarloweSquare
 Removed obsolete Sounds and other Assets
 Rebuilt numerous Biotec and BarloweSquare Props to avoid issues with 
Players & AI
 Fixed a number of scripts for more accurate and improved game-play

notes.title: Contagion - ZombieFest & "Break Down" WebComic :: Volume 3 Week 9
notes.content:
http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2014-09-01_ZombieFest/Contagion_ZombieFest_Flier.jpg

We our very passionate about our work and community and from reactions from Romero's "Finally", to the cast of The Walking Dead sharing interest via tweets, as well as major editors and youtubers showing support it would seem we're not the only ones and feel lucky to have reached so many.

Apparently we reached an entire city that shares our passion for Contagion when a member of the ZombieFest commity in Lakeland, Florida USA introduced themselves and their event and asked if we would be interested in using their Studio (center of the Event), setup our game at the Venue, and be their headline Sponsor as they work towards obtaining the Guinness World Record for having the most "Zombies" in one location which is looking promising with the numbers looking to beat out those in Jersey from last year.

Apparently the City from the Mayors Office to the Police Department (running security) are fans of Contagion which blew our minds and really wanted us to participate when our name came popping up for a Game Center. We've also got Universal Studio's painting people up as Zombies, ZombieFest & Contagion Digital Billboards, Signs on Buses, and more all over Florida (if you're out there, keep your eyes peeled!). 

All of Downtown Lakeland is participating and we're honored to be a part of it. They're even preparing a Cake (4'x3') for us and Most everyone from the team will be there as well a possible Special Guest! We'll also be doing a popular Talk Show (has been hinted there may be more than one) aired during Prime Time which we'll release more information regarding as we learn more but we do know we're recording on the 10th (so we'll be around from Oct 9th - Oct 14th with our Families but remember jet lag, 4am wake up for prep, and more. Doubt we'll need the make-up to pull off a decent zombie).

http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2014-09-01_ZombieFest/Contagion_ZombieFest_Cake.jpg

We're all very excited for the event but this has also locked us down in sorting out updates, hitting deadlines, and preparing the upcoming free DLC! 

We haven't forgotten our Official Weekly WebComic (SickJoe is just that. Sick and we love it! He'll also be attending ZombieFest for fans of his work and may want to learn more about the Future of Monochrome LLC) and so here is our latest update which was unfortunately delayed due to our Weekend promo that is now over and our bandwidth being torn to shreds by the Steam Community heh.

Official Contagion Comic - Chapter 3 :: Week 9

http://www.contagion-game.com/images/comicbook/chapters/contagion_breakdown_cover_620_preview.jpg
http://www.contagion-game.com/images/comicbook/previews/week21/cont_checking_out_wk21_steam.jpg

We're looking into releasing our WebComic in a manageable format as well as our OST which will include our music from the game as well as our cinematic trailer! More surprises on the way and soon!

http://www.monochrome-games.com/site_images/contagion-now-on-steam.png

We really want to meet up with our Fans in Florida so if you can be there on October 11th it'll be hard to miss us. Come on in and say hi, sit down at one of numerous computers and play Contagion! Looking to have some swag and signings of our Comic and more!

If you're new to Contagion but in the area and/or a Zombie enthusiast we still hope to see you there!

-The Contagion Team

notes.title: Contagion - Free Weekend & 75% Discount :: Try Before You Buy!
notes.content:
http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2014-08-28_FreeWeekend/Contagion_Store_Free_Weekend_Discount_Preview.jpg

After some trouble with scheduling in the past we've finally scheduled with Valve our first Free Weekend with a 75% Discount of our first Indie title Contagion. We highly recommend that you play Contagion this weekend and if you've found a game that satisfies your Zombie Apocalypse fantasies and to quote Romero himself "Finally" hope you'll take advantage of our discount and be here for all that is to come, if not we would like to thank those who took the time to give our game a go and hope you'll follow our progress.

Many of our community already know what to expect with a dedicated team of developers who are putting out consistent updates, bug fixes, and listening to feedback that impacts future improvements. Will be continuing to release new content as well as our Free DLC Bundle's (2 are planned at this time) that include in each 4 New Characters, 4 New Weapons, 2 New Maps, and 1 New Game-Mode. 

Our updates are not limited to just content as we're moving forward with our new Mocap Animations on completion of our new layered animation system built from the ground up, further improvements to performance that is always changing our System Requirements, Ability to play with your friends via a Lobby system, Ranking, Stats, New Achievements, Customizable Cosmetics, and Unlockables for Co-op play.

For those new to Contagion and not yet up to speed via our Streams, Videos, Guides, and Forum Posts the following information may help! (PRESS F1 in-game to display your binds)

Contagion :: Game-Modes

Escape (CE_ Prefix)

In Escape you can play up to 8 Survivors trying to escape the location and situation you've found yourself in. With each round objectives, paths, weapon & ammo spawns, as well as zombie spawns are randomly generated making each attempt/round unique from the rest. With the spawning system you can play 100 games that are different from the first. Be sure to follow the instructions and in many cases the distance meter on your smart phone to complete objectives.

Extraction (CX_ Prefix)

In Extraction you and up to 8 total survivors spawn away from your friends and must use your smart phone's GPS to locate each other as well as once your GPS picks up the location the place where survivor AI's are holding out and require your help to barricade, and keep the horde at bay until extraction arrives where you'll need to lead them to and will be rewarded with ammo and weapons. Each holdout is randomly selected as is the number of survivors you must rescue. You lose one of two ways, all AI (even if you only have 1 to protect) die or all Player Survivors die. If you clear out all locations you win.

Hunted (CH_ Prefix)

In Hunted you've been consumed by paranoia, greed, or believe survival lies in the resources you can gather off the corpses of other survivors. You can play up to 8 or 16 players in this game-mode (Depends on server) and you score points for Killing AI/Player Zombies, Survivors, and being the last man/woman standing. You can camp it out, team up, or like most of us enjoy hunt down all survivors hoping to be the last one standing. The winner is the person with the highest score which carries on to the next round.

Contagion Panic Classic (CPC_ Prefix still WIP and Inspired by our Free Mod Zombie Panic: Source which was requested by Contagion Players)

In this game mode you can play up to 8-16 players (depending on server settings) with either 1-2 survivors starting out infected with only them knowing until the change hits so watch your back as your mate may very well be turning into a zombie just behind you. Your goal in Classic is to survive a specified amount of time or kill all the zombies "spotted" in your area which your smart phone will say. There are no AI Zombies, just former survivors who've been infected or have died. Each Player Zombie death drops the number while each survivor turned zombie raises it by one. If the number of zombies spots hits 0 and all zombies are dead you also win.

Contagion Panic Objective (CPO_ Prefix still WIP and Inspired by our Free Mod Zombie Panic: Source which was requested by Contagion Players)

In this game mode you can play up to 8-16 players (depending on server settings) with either 1-2 survivors starting out infected with only them knowing until the change hits so watch your back as your mate may very well be turning into a zombie just behind you. Very much like Escape you must complete a series of objectives but this time without any AI Zombies in your way. Instead you're left fending off those who have turned (Player Zombies) and there is no limit to how often they can spawn, just their numbers which grow as players die. Your smart phone again describes your objectives.



Contagion :: Current Official Maps

RoanokePD

Currently only supports the following Game-Modes "Escape" and "CPO"


http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2014-08-28_FreeWeekend/RoanokePD_Preview.jpg

Barlowe Square

Currently only supports the following Game-Modes "Escape", "Extraction", "Hunted", and "CPC"


http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2014-08-28_FreeWeekend/BarloweSquare_Preview.jpg

Biotec

Currently only supports the following Game-Modes "Escape" and "Hunted"


http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2014-07-31_Biotec/Contagion_Biotec06_th.jpg

Stone Creek

Currently only supports the following Game-Mode "Escape"


http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2014-07-31_Biotec/Contagion_StoneCreek01_th.jpg

Aurora Estates

Currently only supports the following Game-Modes "Extraction" and "Hunted"


http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2014-08-28_FreeWeekend/AuroraEstates_Preview.jpg

Cyprus Park

Currently only supports the following Game-Modes "Hunted" and "CPC"


http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2014-08-28_FreeWeekend/CyprusPark_Preview.jpg

Pioneer Express

Currently only supports the following Game-Modes "Hunted" and "CPC"


http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2014-08-28_FreeWeekend/PioneerExpress_Preview.jpg

There is quite a lot more that we do like our Weekly Official Contagion WebComic, "Friday Frenzy" and "Contagious Gaming" Stream & Giveaway, daily interaction with the community trying to show we're not here to make a quick buck but want to help where we can and appreciate constructive criticism.

Have a great Weekend!

Extraction (CX_ Prefix)

In Extraction you and up to 8 total survivors spawn away from your friends and must use your smart phone's GPS to locate each other as well as once your GPS picks up the location the place where survivor AI's are holding out and require your help to barricade, and keep the horde at bay until extraction arrives where you'll need to lead them to and will be rewarded with ammo and weapons. Each holdout is randomly selected as is the number of survivors you must rescue. You lose one of two ways, all AI (even if you only have 1 to protect) die or all Player Survivors die. If you clear out all locations you win.

Hunted (CH_ Prefix)

In Hunted you've been consumed by paranoia, greed, or believe survival lies in the resources you can gather off the corpses of other survivors. You can play up to 8 or 16 players in this game-mode (Depends on server) and you score points for Killing AI/Player Zombies, Survivors, and being the last man/woman standing. You can camp it out, team up, or like most of us enjoy hunt down all survivors hoping to be the last one standing. The winner is the person with the highest score which carries on to the next round.

Contagion Panic Classic (CPC_ Prefix still WIP and Inspired by our Free Mod Zombie Panic: Source which was requested by Contagion Players)

In this game mode you can play up to 8-16 players (depending on server settings) with either 1-2 survivors starting out infected with only them knowing until the change hits so watch your back as your mate may very well be turning into a zombie just behind you. Your goal in Classic is to survive a specified amount of time or kill all the zombies "spotted" in your area which your smart phone will say. There are no AI Zombies, just former survivors who've been infected or have died. Each Player Zombie death drops the number while each survivor turned zombie raises it by one. If the number of zombies spots hits 0 and all zombies are dead you also win.

Contagion Panic Objective (CPO_ Prefix still WIP and Inspired by our Free Mod Zombie Panic: Source which was requested by Contagion Players)

In this game mode you can play up to 8-16 players (depending on server settings) with either 1-2 survivors starting out infected with only them knowing until the change hits so watch your back as your mate may very well be turning into a zombie just behind you. Very much like Escape you must complete a series of objectives but this time without any AI Zombies in your way. Instead you're left fending off those who have turned (Player Zombies) and there is no limit to how often they can spawn, just their numbers which grow as players die. Your smart phone again describes your objectives.

 Added gasmask objective item that prevents harmful chemicals from affecting player
 Added gasmask voice muffling for survivors
 Added Keycard objective item for unlocking security doors
 Added keycard entity system for mappers
 Added Zombie Decapitation with bladed weapons (Kabar not included)

 Improved navigation mesh for all existing maps
 Changes to networking system in an attempt to fix LAN related issues

notes.title: Contagion - Update June 16th :: Split Screen Local Co-op, AI tweaks, Linux/Mac Update, and much more!
notes.content:
http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2013_09_13_Kickstarter/Contagion_Logo_450.png

It's been a long time coming for many but we've finally added Local Co-op Split-screen without the need like other games to go through a series of steps to get it working right. 2 Game-pads, Keyboard & Mouse & Game-pad, the days of Consoles and PC games lacking this feature may be dying out but this is something we grew up with and playing with a friend or sibling without having to lan was a hot topic for gamers and owners of Contagion so we can now tick our Local Co-op in the listings. We will continue to watch over it and tweak here and there to improve the overall quality of course (no aim assist for game-pads, sorry heh).

http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2014-06-16_Update_Splitscreen/Contagion_Local_Coop_Splitscreen.jpg

Our Survivor AI accuracy is dependent on difficulty as well as commands that are allowed making Extraction while it was still difficult, more realistic and this will only improve throughout the year.

We've also enabled more server commands for Server Hosts to use to setup their servers closer to what they'd like them to be (Dec went to bed and I don't have the list heh)

Check out the changes below in this weeks update-

Contagion - Update June 16th Changelog:

 Added split-screen support to Contagion, also added menu in options to enable it. (WIP)
 Adjusted survivor AI accuracy to be less perfect on easier difficulties.
 Enabled additional console commands to be allowed to be changed by server hosts.
 Fixed the ability to drop a grenade before infection and kill ex-teammates.
 Fixed survivor AI being able to receive commands while inside a house or while climbing.
 Fixed IED and phone screen disappearing near water or mirror elements sometimes.
 Fixed memory leak issues with multiple flash-lights.
 Fixed possible server crash-loop when blending as a zombie.


http://www.monochrome-games.com/Media/2014-06-16_Update_Splitscreen/linux_mac_icon.png This week we have updates on both Linux and the Mac build. Valve has been quite helpful in keeping on things an we have started working not only on our Linux but also our Mac builds! Whether they are able to release simultaneously or not is yet to be seen but this is great news to those who are eager to play Contagion on their Linux machine/Steam Machine and/or Mac!

Also for those that missed our Official Contagion - Let's Play Top 10 Countdown with prizes exceeding $12,500 check it out!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=DOyyfFzsE5g

http://www.monochrome-games.com/site_images/contagion-now-on-steam.png

Next week we're hoping to release our updated melee system that will definitely change the way the game is played and for many this is also another update that's been eagerly awaited. Will also try and grab some sneak peaks of our current maps in development/nearing release like CE_Biotec :)

He're a look at what we're working on atm - -Here-

http://www.contagion-game.com/site_images/networks/steam.png http://www.contagion-game.com/site_images/networks/facebook.png http://www.contagion-game.com/site_images/networks/twitter.png http://www.contagion-game.com/site_images/networks/youtube.png http://www.contagion-game.com/site_images/networks/indiedb.png

-The Contagion Team

notes.title: Contagion - Update June 4th :: Crossbow deadlier than ever, Linux Update, and 9 Ways Contagion Brings the Zombie Genre Back From the Dead!
notes.content:
I apologize for the delay in announcing a release that went out nearly 12 hours ago but sometimes this is a good sign and in our case and for the future of Contagion it is! We hope you approve of the weekly updates and will be releasing more content shortly and more often very soon!


9 Ways Contagion Brings the Zombie Genre Back From the Dead :: Game Cupid
“Oh great! Another generic zombie game!” I hear you say. 
Stop rolling your eyes a second and hear me out.
We can't help but get a jump start when Contagion goes from a generic Zombie game to a "Oh" moment and the hard work, design, and depth of the game just clicks for users. No hand holding, but a well thought out and challenging game that attempts to hit the mark but only time will tell.

Check out the full review at GameCupid.com

Where we are at with Linux (Linux Update as promised)
Linux progresses and we're quite confident that we'll soon be able to release our Linux and Mac platforms soon but as we said last week there are walls and the latest one is an issue with networking on Valve's end. Will keep you up to date but have made vast steps forward since the last update.

Here is what we put out in today's patch

June 4th Update - Changelog:

 Added 'you are here' maps around Barlowe to help navigation.
 Added glow symbol underneath infected survivors when seen through zombie vision.
 Added additional checks to try solve invisible survivor glitch.
 Improved many areas on Barlowe square and fixed lots of exploited areas.
 Riot zombies in Panic gamemodes can now cause infection with claws but not with grapple bite.
 Bigger penalty in Hunted for suicide and new penalty for drawing a round.
 Many navmesh fixes to Barlowe Square to help with Extraction.
 Fixed zombies disappearing when killed instead of seeing a corpse.
 Adjustments to crossbow accuracy and power.
 Adjusted GPS in Barlowe Extraction to not be so bright.
 Adjusted delay after grapple that zombies can hit survivors.
 Adjusted microphone drawing in Panic gamemodes scoreboard.
 Adjusted 16 player scoreboard to change to 16 slot layout when number of players goes above 8.
 Adjusted character breathing sounds when running out of stamina.
 Fixed ability for some weapons to do large friendly fire on Normal difficulty.
 Fixed ability to join a Hunted game as a survivor in the last remaining minutes.
 Fixed pathing entities causing navigation issues on Barlowe.
 Removed per-difficulty damage adjustment for Grenades.


Due to the hours and sleep deprivation and so I can focus on getting new content out like CE_Biotec ASAP, Joe is stepping in handle our General Discussion. Please be gentle! We will still be watching over and helping those in need however!



He're a look at what we're working on atm - -Here-

    

-The Contagion Team

notes.title: Contagion - Update May 18th :: Increased Player Slots, New SDK/Workshop, and Linux?
notes.content:
Today's update was a blast but means a bit more work for us as we've been keeping busy (wait for the gasmask). We no longer have an in-game workshop publishing tool due to the limitations it set. We've updated our ContagionSDK to include our Workshop Publishing Tool which now allows what it couldn't before the option to review your screenshot, update existing addons, update details of addons, and all a modders could hope for. We can add to this later thanks to the setup as well.




With the new PANIC modes we had been testing 16 players using bots. But because we could never get enough ppl together in team due to our small numbers we put it out there and testing was a huge success!

Both Hunted and our Panic Game-Modes support 16 players (our Escape and Extraction game modes do not at this time) and we've got our Official Contagion Gameservers Servers running 16 slots right now (Their is maintenance being done over at GS so there may be stragglers which we'll go over)! Gameservers has updated their options from 8 slots to now being able to rent between 8 and 16 slots.



This is going to require balancing and don't worry the HUD is temporary! Replacements coming soon.



Also for those who've been patiently been sitting around we want you to know that we will have an update regarding Linux at the end of the month. Michael Brune is working hard solely on the release of both the Server Binaries and Platform! (More on Mac asap!)

May 18th Update - Changelog:


 Added Hunted and both Panic game-modes the ability to play up to 16 players now
 Added Contagion Workshop Manager to the ContagionSDK. Removed in-game add-on publisher for favour of better software
 Added ability for mappers to set different spawn weapons for survivors
 Tweaked HUD elements to support 16 players on those servers
 Fixed riot-zombie having female legs for those who picked a female character
 Fixed issue with first-person hands movement 'lagging' when in dedicated servers
 Fixes to Barlowe Square nav-mesh, fenced areas and fixed some camping spots


Remember more updates this month and major updates every month of 2014 so keep checking in for more info!



He're a look at what we're working on atm - -Here-

    

-The Contagion Team

notes.title: Contagion - Early May Updates! Check out the new video!
notes.content:
As you know now we've released our Official Contagion SDK Authoring Tools, Steam Workshop (Update on that soon!), Contagion WIKI, and Modding Discussions as many of us started out as modders and still strongly believe in the modding community even as we release unofficial mods ourselves and continue to improve on the tools and tutorials!



Speaking of improvements! Our guys and FXBooth have been working hard improving animations, effects, facial expressions, visuals, audio, and more for our Enhanced Contagion - Source Filmmaker Cinematic Trailer which is different enough you've got to check it out now in full 1080p! For those that are curious the songs name is "Sleep" by Forbnl (Ed Harrison & John Dekker)



We also released the much anticipated and requested Contagion Panic Game-Modes Inspired by my very own award winning Zombie Panic: Source HL2 Modification! (We still plan to find the time to undo the damage done with the last couple leads and get it up and rolling again bigger and better as soon as that is possible)



We know many are already using the modding tools to port some of our favorite maps over and others have shown a strong interest in modding for it.

As we've made clear, this does not replace ZPS but we're hoping our veterans will step in and help us in quickly balancing it out. We're looking for enthusiasts in this regard to post in our Contagion Panic Specific Discussion




We've mentioned CE_Biotec is nearly complete and hinted at CE_Harvest as well as our upcoming DLC Bundle, Flatline Game-Mode, New Characters, Weapons, and much more.



Have a look at our current updates in more detail below!

May 11th Update - Changelog


 Added Contagion Steam Workshop and full in-game addon publishing support
 Added Panic Classic and Objective game-modes
 Added Panic game-mode to pre-existing maps (look forward to seeing your published maps)
 Added Riot Zombie as Player Controlled main zombie for Panic game-modes
 Added Riot Zombie first-person hand textures
 Added New Zombie Player HUD
 Added Golf-Club Kick-starter weapon
 Added Player Zombie 'Command' ability to control a horde that is following you
 Added Survivor breathing sounds when sprinting
 Further optimisation to hit-box code to try improve on current system
 Fixed random survivor changing per round


May 12th Update - Changelog


 Improved zombie pathing on Barlowe Square
 Fixed Achievements and Key Binds menu elements not being visible
 Improved code that gets rid of used weapons when their action is complete (e.g. FirstAid Kit)
 Fixed non-chosen player always being the Riot Zombie in Panic game-modes
 Fixed flashlight sound repeating, when on dedicated servers
 Fixed AI zombies not spawning when changing from a Panic server
 Fixed broken survivors spawn system on Escape maps
 Improved zombie pathing on Barlowe Square
 Fixed Eugene's materials to glow when he is seen through Zombie Vision
 Fixed IED quick-dropping glitch that caused weapon HUD to order incorrectly


May ??? Update - Changelog


 More! Remember, we're listening to you guys so don't be afraid to share constructive criticism with us!


Something worth mentioning is our attendance this year at Downtown Lakeland, Florida's ZombieFest this October 11th as they reach for this years Guinness World Record for most Zombies in one location and Contagion will be the one and only game setup at the local Club right in the middle of it all! We plan to go big and many of the team will be there including myself for a change!



More updates throughout the month and every month of 2014!

He're a look at what we're working on atm - -Here-

    

-The Contagion Team

notes.title: Contagion - Update April 27th
notes.content:
This weeks update features Survivor AI that can hold their own while on their own or as they follow you to the extraction point as well as a number of improvements and major fixes! Here's a look at the changelog for today's update-

Contagion - Update April 27th

 Survivor AI now have weapons, better AI, better navigation and voices.
 Adjustments to zombie sounds attenuation and variety.
 Added ability to load multiple .bnk files for custom add-on maps.
 Added new clipping types for mappers to block areas for specifically zombies or survivors.
 Added better communication system with AI survivors and the ability to command them with voice-commands.
 Improved AI for Survivors when they're being extracted.
 Optimisations to zombie AI to speed up net-load.
 Fixed VOIP issues and icon above survivors heads at all times.
 Fixed cheat-detection code being activated by servers with non-default tick-rates.
 Fixed survivors not actually escaping at the end of escape and still existing in the world.
 Fixed grenade damage not killing players on all difficulties.
 Fixed Draw and Holster sounds being audible to everyone when a survivor spawns.
 Fixed zombies spawning in extraction areas on Barlowe.
 Fixed broken pathing near gunstore on Barlowe.
 Fixed issues with ForcedIP being enabled for people who don't need it.
 Fixed spawning in the bank at random times on Barlowe Escape.
 Fixed fences in Barlowe not being able to be climbed by Zombie players or AI.
 Fixed Survivor voices.
 Fixed glass being able to be broken on non-active houses by throwing weapons at the glass.
 Fixed net_graph showing for users who didn't enable it.


Remember these fixes may still be updating on our servers so if you receive a **** differs error it just means the server is not yet updated. The update is still going out to servers.

There are less than 2 weeks left before we lock down our "Contagon - Let's Play" competition. May 9th we stop accepting new videos and start judging them!

Contagion - Let's Play Competition with prizes exceeding $12,500 USD

For information visit- http://www.contagion-game.com/lets-play/

and/or watch our instructional video





We've got major updates every month leading into 2015 but keep up on what we're working on atm -Here-

    

-The Contagion Team

notes.title: Official Contagion SDK is out now!
notes.content:
Actually it was released on Sunday as planned but one of our marketing campaign affiliates used us to host the image on their site for a site takeover and we nearly lost hosting. Upgraded and sorted now!



We've updated your Contagion with our Official Contagion SDK which can be found in your Steam\Common\Contagion\bin\ (or ContagionBeta if you bought before Full Release) folder as it's directly linked to our Engine.

We are excited to see what you guys roll out and what becomes popular. We can only hope that some of you try to achieve more than a simple port or something rushed but it available to do just that if you wish.

notes.title: Contagion Update - Hotfix 2014-04-17
notes.content:
Here is our latest hotfix that should if all goes as planned resolve the existing bugs troubling a number of you. We will keep an eye out and do our best to jump on anything that may pop up as we have since before "Early Release" heh. Thank you for your patience and we hope you didn't have to wait too long. A few more updates added that should please some as well!

Contagion - Hotfix 2014-04-17

 Fixed shadow glitching to low-quality when sprinting or zombie.
 Added -tickrate back to code so servers can custom-set 66 tickrate servers.
 Added ability to force public IP display in listen servers.
 Adjusted memory loading method for Sounds in attempt to fix missing sounds ingame.
 Getting infected and turning into a zombie now keeps the same character model but zombie version.
 Fixed zombies not spawning after first round of Extraction on Barlowe.
 Fixed glitch where you can get infected twice, cancelling the first infection timer.[/code]
 Fixed infection glitch spawning you in offset new places.
 Fixed double-sounds from survivors when melee attacking.


Remember these fixes may still be updating on our servers so if you receive a **** differs error it just means the server is not yet updated. The update is still going out to servers.

Always an important topic to remind everyone of!

notes.title: Contagion - Major optimization and more with today's hotfix!
notes.content:
We had our Full Release on Friday and are still waiting for Valve to fix the listing issue. But with full release we ran into issues that weren't present through testing and many users with low end rigs and those who use to play even below supported min system requirements were dealing with crashes.

We released a hotfix with major optimization tweaks that should have resolved all/most of those issues. We will continue to optimize and improve the quality of the latest content (yes including characters which is already being worked on) and some features that are acting up (voice volume). We did more than that with todays update so below is the changelog-

Contagion :: 2014-04-13 Update/Hotfix

 Heavily optimised game resources by almost half when settings are lowered
 Fixed players standing on ladders stopping zombies from climbing up
 Fixed and added back IED weapon
 Fixed zombie spawns on Barlowe servers causing MAX EDICTS crash
 Removed lots of unnecessary resources from the game
 Disabled tossing objective items out of the loading bay
 Fixed getting stuck in the overturned train in Pioneer
 Added security cameras to Barlowe escape
 Fixed cameras in RPD to show correctly for all players
 Fixed lighting in Subway on Barlowe Escape
 Fixed Singleplayer/LAN servers having default passwords
 Fixed AI zombies getting stuck in RPD vent
 Fixed AI zombies standing up and getting stuck when in areas that require crouching
 Game now reads the update text on a second thread to remove the delay that sometimes occurs.
 Fixed dropped weapons colliding with invisible barricade positions
 Adjusted loading-screen to recieve additional messages to help keep up with changing levels
 AI survivors now have the ability to climb ladders, small props and fences instead of getting stuck
 AI survivors also now have the ability to get un-stuck much easier and build better paths to follow survivors
 Fixed being able to spawn outside the map on Barlowe
 Many navmesh fixes for various maps
 Fixed indoor rain FX on Barlowe




We are listening and will continue to improve, add, and optimize. Yes we're also working on the SDK for a release here very soon, also working on Linux and Mac and hope to announce their release dates shortly.

    

-The Contagion Team

notes.title: Contagion - Full Release is out! But still running on 25% discount?
notes.content:
After 5 hours of waiting on Valve to flip the switch and release our game at full price ($19.99) as Full Release on the Store's front page we felt we could wait no longer and decided to release on the date we announced repeatedly! TODAY (Yesterday for some as it's now 10am and I look forward to bed as does the rest of the team)!

While it states we're currently early access we are no longer that. Yes there are bugs and hotfixes we're already planning to release immediately (after sleep... still human) like the IED which somehow got bugged but is too awesome to leave out, the design and so very much of our work is out there now! We don't mind the pricing, we just want you guys to have what was promised and we will be at it every day till you have it.

We will be releasing the Contagion SDK if all goes this Sunday (again, so long as nothing goes wrong) as well as other updates. This does not mean we won't be hotfixing any issues you guys come across so post bugs in our Bug Reports discussions so we can do just that!

We really hope you like the changes, and are excited for the future updates like the 1000+ Mocap animations we've been preparing since we recorded them, Linux & Mac platforms (binaries for servers to come when that comes out. No date yet but we're nearing a point where we can announce that) some other big surprises as well. I apologize for the rambling but we've been up days and so very tired. Know that we won't let you down and will enjoy the hard work everyone put into this major release.

Full Release - Update Log

 New Character Designs.
 Barlowe Square Escape Map.
 Added Difficulty options to Contagion.
 New menu background videos.
 New menu background video play-list and loading code.
 New entire UI redesign.
 New loading icon and loading screen.
 New splash screen.
 Added achievements.
 Added achievements viewer page under Extras.
 Created new map and gamemode selecting element.
 New start game menu.
 New find-game menu with matchmaking styled background server finding.
 Completed 100% controller support for all menu's.
 Controller settings options menu.
 New keyboard bind menu.
 Added new main-menu track and optional menu track to play on load.
 New loading and credits music tracks.
 Fixed ironsight toggle bugs and new system allows ironsight and duck toggle options instead of seporate key binds.
 Added SteamCloud support game configuration file.
 New map pictures for start and find game.
 Added difficulty option elements to find and start game.
 Fixed character selection being dark or completely black.
 Fixed zombies standing up in vents to attack.
 Fixed zombie AI issues when tracking sounds causing expensive AI calculations.
 Added Extreme difficulty and difficulty based console commands for each difficulty.
 Fixed doors opening then instantly closing on high-ping servers.
 Added difficulty tag to servers.
 Added voice commands and character voices.
 Added auto voice commands.
 Fixed sounds not starting properly on RPD.
 Fixed infection effects appearing on new round.
 Fixed muffled sounds caused by ingame pause menu.
 Fixed muffled sounds when in low health.
 Fixed old GPS position being shown to survivors on a new round in Extraction.
 Fixed fires setting AI survivors on fire.
 Fixed zombie players from dying instantly when on fire.
 Fixed breakable glass sounds and amount of damage glass does to players.
 Optimised flashlight code for far away players.
 Fixed drop weapon and drop ammo to not 'poop' the ammo out.
 Also fixed ammo bunching up and floating when dropped in large amounts.
 Fixed commenting on finding a weapon or ammo straight after or before picking up an item.
 Added survivor voice commands and sounds. E.g. jump, pain, die or melee attack.
 Added infection on zombie damage chance for specific difficulties.
 Added proper gamemode logic and settings for different difficulties.
 New weapon 'BLR' added to game along with new sniper and BLR ammo.
 Added holstering weapons when climbing a ladder.
 Fixed zombies climbing as often when not needed.
 Made zombie, item, weapon and ammo spawns in maps adjusted by difficulty.
 New weapon 'IED'.
 IED icon changing added.
 New zombie type 'Riot Police'. Super tough zombies that can't be headshotted.
 Added arrow ammo pack that contains 6 arrows instead of individual arrows.
 Added ability to enable/disable infection and/or zombie players in your own servers.
 New zombie type 'Inmates'. More common in RPD, less common in Aurora.
 Implemented and finalized all achievements.


DO NOT FORGET OUR $12,500+ "Contagion - Let's Play" Competition



Today we also start our "Contagion - Let's Play" Competition. Visit http://www.contagion-game.com for more details and to get started as well as rules. We can't wait to see what you have in store for us!



Once again thank you for your patience and incredible support!

-The Contagion Team

notes.title: Contagion - Update 4872 includes Barlowe Square "Extraction", Optimization, Hud updates, and much more
notes.content:
We recently revealed Barlowe Square with the "Hunted" game-mode and today we released "Extraction" as promised. We're currently working on further optimizing and polishing Barlowe Square as well as "Escape" but we haven't stopped there as work on a new firearm.

April 11th we will release a more optimized version of Contagion with improved AI, Full Release final features (more to come later), fully polished, and following the release we will continue with our Contagion SDK release, Achievements, Steamworks, Gametracker, Sourcemod, new content, even more free content in the form of Free DLC bundles. While we're excited we also quite nervous even with all the praise and support of our community which we're incredibly grateful for.

We have some exciting stuff coming up we've kept to our selves as a surprise to our community and we hope you'll be just as stoked as we are when we reveal it. That said we just finished our Recent Facebook competition with numerous entries and will be announcing the winners on the 20th!


We look forward to announcing the winners and future winners!

"Early Access" BUILD 4872

 Added new version of Barlowe Square "Extraction" which is very much a WIP
 Improved and fixed navmesh and spawn issues on Barlowe Square "Hunted"
 Optimised weapon HUD code, added new commands and system for HUD and switching weapons (Required to update weapon select binds both mouse wheel and keys)
 Fixed bug that caused weapon commands not to work properly
 Melee weapons are now able to smash out our new glass saving on ammo
 Added End Of Round UI for each gamemode with new awards and stats for specific modes coming soon
 Flashlights for other players now have LOD's which causes players further away from rendering full expensive lights
 New ambient sounds for Barlowe Square to fix missing rain sounds when outside
 Adjusted lighting and weapons on Pioneer Express
 Optimised flashlight code when turning flashlights on for the first time
 New props and detailing on Barlowe Square and Pioneer Express
 Fixed navmesh issues on Barlowe Square and Pioneer Express







Friday Frenzy Returns!
I chose to cancel last weeks Friday Frenzy to watch my daughter graduate and share what she learned over the year. I am a proud daddy but I'm looking forward to returning to our weekly schedule!

Here is Episode 19 (sorry for my cold) and Episode 20 is this Friday!

http://youtu.be/y1JgMwQJDiI



We stream our Official Contagion "Friday Frenzy" and/or "Contagious Gaming" via our Twitch.Tv Account at- http://www.twitch.tv/tatsur0 every Friday @ 7:00PM PST/PDT (GMT- 8:00) -Click here for current time- and will pass out one or more free copies of Contagion during the Stream!

We're very close to Release so for those who've shown their support be vigilant and be sure to report any bugs you run into whether or not we may know of them. We want to release a solid title you all can be proud of! We want to thank all of you again for everything!





    

-The Contagion Team
